description: This file declares an interface IEventHandler within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. The interface defines several pure virtual methods for handling various runtime, window, ripple, and state change events, which operate on JSON objects or strings. It serves as a contract for handling specific events within a plugin architecture.

classes.name: IEventHandler
classes.description: A pure virtual interface for handling various plugin-related events.

methods.name: onRuntimeManagerEvent
methods.description: Handles runtime manager events with associated JSON data.

methods.name: onWindowManagerEvent
methods.description: Handles window manager events with associated JSON data.

methods.name: onRippleEvent
methods.description: Handles ripple events identified by a name and associated JSON data.

methods.name: onStateChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles general state change events with associated JSON data.
